core_meaning.primary_meaning: Rayhanat is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Fragrant herb”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rayhanat corresponds to the Arabic form رَيْحَانَات (Arabic root ر و ح (r-w-ḥ); رَيْحَانَات (Rayḥānāt)). Its core sense is rayhanat; fragrant herbs (plural). Rayhanat is Arabic رَيْحَانَات (Rayḥānāt), the plural of رَيْحَانَة (Rayḥāna) 'fragrant herb', used as a female given name. The source gloss 'Fragrant flowers' is broadly consistent.
